import json, os, sys, time, tempfile, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime
t0 = time.monotonic(); ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1073741824, 1073741824))
def T(S): return S ^ ((S << 1) | (S << 2))
def f(a, b, c): return a ^ (b | c)
row = 1
for want in (1, 7, 25, 111, 401):
    assert row == want, (row, want)
    row = T(row)
OFF, SZ, TMAX = 40, 120, 11
def step(row):
    out = [0]*SZ
    for i in range(1, SZ-1): out[i] = f(row[i-1], row[i], row[i+1])
    return out
for S in range(1, 64, 2):
    r = [0]*SZ
    for k in range(20): r[OFF-k] = (S >> k) & 1
    Rt = S
    for t in range(TMAX+1):
        Et = 0
        for k in range(t+21): Et |= (r[OFF+t-k] << k)
        assert Et == Rt, (S, t, hex(Et), hex(Rt))
        r = step(r); Rt = T(Rt)
print('CA-vs-packed agree: odd S<64, t<=11')
import math
R = {}
wit = {}
for d in range(2, 13):
    Sd = {}
    for S in range(1, 64, 2):
        s = S.bit_length()
        if s > d // 2: continue
        n = d - s
        Rn = S
        for _ in range(n): Rn = T(Rn)
        X = Rn >> n
        assert X.bit_length() == d, (S, n, X)
        Sd.setdefault(X, []).append([S, n])
    R[d] = sorted(Sd); wit[d] = Sd
print('sizes:', {d: len(R[d]) for d in R})
found = None
for d in range(4, 13):
    Rd2 = set(R[d-2])
    for x in R[d]:
        if (x >> 2) not in Rd2:
            found = {'d': d, 'x_hex': hex(x), 'x': x, 'pi_hex': hex(x >> 2),
                     'witnesses': wit[d][x], 'lower_R': R[d-2]}
            break
    if found: break
print('first failure:', None if not found else (found['d'], found['x_hex']))
cpu = next((l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')), 'unknown')
src = open(__file__).read()
summary = {'hand_row_S1': [1, 7, 25, 111, 401], 'ca_agree': True, 'sizes': {'%02d' % d: len(R[d]) for d in R},
 'R_sets': {'%02d' % d: R[d] for d in R}, 'first_failure': found, 'hypothesis_holds_to_12': found is None}
rec = {'experiment_id': '20260905_physical_projection_box', 'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
 'question': 'problem1', 'hypothesis': 'Physical half-row projection pi(R_d) stays in R_{d-2} for d>=4 (S=1 hand row, CA cross-check, box d<=12).',
 'backend': 'python-cellarray-vs-packed-exhaustive-box', 'parameters': {'d_range': [4, 12], 'S_odd_below': 64, 't_max': 11, 'order': 'd-ascending-then-x-ascending-stop-first', 'wall_limit_seconds': 120, 'address_space_bytes': 1073741824},
 'hardware': {'cpu_model': cpu, 'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count(), 'peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},
 'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()}, 'runtime_seconds': time.monotonic()-t0,
 'result_hashes': {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(), 'result_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()},
 'source_text': src, 'result_summary': summary,
 'interpretation': 'Pass supports attempting stripped-digit induction on the physical domain; failure blocks that shortcut (physical-only invariants may still survive).',
 'status': 'finite-exhaustive', 'proof_scope': 'Exact R_2..R_12 from all odd S<64; first-failure search d=4..12. No larger box.',
 'limitations': ['Box d<=12 only; no projection-closure claim.', 'No claim every degree-d integer is physical.']}
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', prefix='rec_', suffix='.tmp')
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(rec, f, sort_keys=True, indent=2); f.write(chr(10)); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, '/tmp/physproj_check.json')
print('wrote /tmp/physproj_check.json')
